For each of the following steps define the reply of the ECU considering that for each
step the diagnostic service 19 02 08 is requested by a diagnostic tool. Consider also
the following information:
● Enable condition to monitor fault = push CC button;
● Fault condition = SCB (short circuit to battery) on CC button;
● Warning lamp MIL ON 1 at the first driving cycle;
● Warning lamp heal after 2 driving cycles;
● Setting time and healing time are event based;
● DTC code “00 25” + symptom 00
● Consider bit 4 and 5 as not used
● Driving cycle: engine run
● Monitoring cycle: from key on to key off, including a driving cycle
● Consider all actions, for every step, as completely done
ID Manoeuvre ECU response to 19 02 08
1 Vehicle in speed limitation
with cruise control
2 Key off/key on
3 SCB on CC button
4 Push CC button
5 Key off/ key on
6 Engine run
7 Key off/ key on
8 Push CC button
9 Remove SCB on CC button
